root_field_shapes.reader: Safe human-readable label without operational task paths
root_field_shapes.actual_pair_ids_viewed: Unique pair IDs actually inspected on native paired boards; exactly the intake scope
root_field_shapes.target_observations: List of target records covering exactly the intake target IDs
root_field_shapes.pair_observations: List of pair records covering exactly the intake pair IDs

target_record_shape.source_context_ids: Actual tight and expanded context IDs for this target

FEATURE_DIMENSION_FROM_SAFE_PROTOCOL.observation: Fresh concrete source fact; name unresolved information explicitly
FEATURE_DIMENSION_FROM_SAFE_PROTOCOL.native_locator_boxes: List of valid native-coordinate search rectangles relevant to this target route
FEATURE_DIMENSION_FROM_SAFE_PROTOCOL.source_context_ids: Known source context IDs for this target

target_record_shape.free_end_observations: List of route_element_shape records; include unresolved competing endpoints rather than treating them as absent
target_record_shape.competing_routes: List of records with neighbor_ids, native_locator_boxes, source_context_ids, ownership, actual_visibility, continuity_source_witness

route_element_shape.description: Concrete source fact about a free end, bar, return or junction
route_element_shape.continuity_source_witness: Concrete continuity/independent-ending evidence; no proximity-only ownership
route_element_shape.neighbor_ids: Referenced competing annotation IDs, or empty list when none identified

pair_record_shape.actual_native_board_id: Known paired board ID containing this pair's target tight/context views

FEATURE_DIMENSION_FROM_SAFE_PROTOCOL.paired_source_grounds: Concrete paired source relation; preserve observed variation
FEATURE_DIMENSION_FROM_SAFE_PROTOCOL.source_context_ids: Known tight/context IDs for both targets

pair_record_shape.candidate_outcome: One allowed_candidate_outcomes value; never a cipher cannot-link
pair_record_shape.significant_variation: List of concrete variations; do not normalize a terminal/bar/return away
pair_record_shape.remaining_uncertainty: List of concrete missing/ambiguous observations, or empty list

serialization: UTF-8 JSON; freeze initial report before reading historical claims or the other initial report. Later historical audits are separate immutable addenda. Omit all per-panel/body/row pixel hash values.
